description: Incoming edge direction + bare-variable projection (SCHEMA.md §5). MATCH (a:User)<-[:FOLLOWS]-(b:User) reads the FOLLOWS edge as b->a, so a is the edge's destination. WHERE filters on b (the follower). RETURN a projects a node reference, ordered by a.name.
query: MATCH (a:User)<-[:FOLLOWS]-(b:User) WHERE b.name = 'a' RETURN a ORDER BY a.name
